Multimodal AI

You might say

Can AI understand my screenshot too, not just the text I send it?

AI that can combine information such as text, images, audio, or video in one task·Send a screenshot of a phone checkout page with the question “Why is the payment button missing?” and the AI can consider both the visible layout and your written question.
Know first
AI Application Basics
Multimodality
Separate input modes from output modes
Current example: use a screenshot to find why the payment button disappearedThe theme color marks what this example actually uses
Input modalitiesWhat you give the AI
  • Text
  • Image
  • Speech / audioSpeech is audio
  • Video
→
AI model / systemProcesses what it actually supports
→
Output modalitiesWhat the AI returns
  • Text
  • Image
  • Speech / audioSpeech is audio
  • Video

This example takes text and images as input and returns text. Supporting image input does not mean it can output images.

What different modes contribute

A mode is a form of information: Text, images, audio, and video are common modes. Support for one does not mean support for all.

The same mode can be on either side: Audio can be input for transcription or output that reads an answer aloud.

Check the specific product: Supported inputs, outputs, and file types vary by model and product.

What people often confuse

An upload control shows product interaction support, not necessarily a native multimodal model. Verify important results against the original source or real project.

You can say this to an AI Agent

“

This screenshot shows the checkout page on a phone. The payment button should be at the bottom, but it is not visible. First, use only the screenshot to identify any visible overlap or layout clues, and say when the image is not enough to confirm something. Then inspect the mobile layout in the project, fix the cause, and verify at the same screen size that the button is visible and clickable.
